account.riskPolicy: existing BOO risk-policy/risk-budget plus operator-tightened limits

candidates.name: BREAKOUT_RETEST_HOLD_2M
candidates.hypothesis: A leader breakout becomes actionable only after a completed retest holds structure and a second completed bar recovers the breakout with rising buyer share.
rules: after the original trigger, wait for exactly two fully completed 1m bars
bar 1 low <= original trigger close, low >= setup low, and close >= signal reference
bar 2 low >= bar 1 low and close > original trigger high
bar 2 taker-buy quote ratio > bar 1 and >= 0.55
enter at the next bar open, triggerAt+2m

candidates.name: CONTROLLED_PULLBACK_RECLAIM_3M
candidates.hypothesis: A short controlled pullback that preserves the setup and is reclaimed by stronger buyer flow separates continuation from immediate failure.
rules: after the original trigger, wait for exactly three fully completed 1m bars
all three lows remain >= setup low
at least one of bars 1-2 closes below trigger close but >= signal reference
bar 3 closes above trigger close and above both prior closes
bar 3 taker-buy quote ratio > quote-weighted mean of bars 1-2 and >= 0.58
enter at the next bar open, triggerAt+3m

candidates.name: BREAKOUT_ACCEPTANCE_3M
candidates.hypothesis: Repeated completed closes above a breakout with reference preservation indicate price acceptance rather than a one-bar spike.
rules: after the original trigger, wait for exactly three fully completed 1m bars
all three lows remain >= signal reference
at least two closes are > original trigger high
final close >= first close and lies in the upper half of its candle
enter at the next bar open, triggerAt+3m

holdoutPolicy: Do not open walk-forward or reserved holdout unless a preregistered candidate passes every development gate.
